scripts.text:
[Harad]
Hello, guest.
This place is the docks.
scripts.translation:
[哈拉德]
你好，客人。
這裡是碼頭。

scripts.text:
[Harad]
We don't have any ships operating right now. But the scenery is nice, feel free to take a look around for a while!
scripts.translation:
[哈拉德]
現在沒有船執行，不過這裡風景很好，可以四處看看！

scripts.text:
[Harad]
In accordance with the Gardeners' plant cultivation and herbicide plans. Admission to the water garden is limited once per day for both the normal and hard water garden.
scripts.translation:
[哈拉德]
為配合園丁的植物培育和除草計劃，水花園普通模式、困難模式每天都只允許進入一次。

scripts.text:
[Harad]
Thank you for your understanding.
Please take enough rest and come back again after dawn!
scripts.translation:
[哈拉德]
感謝您的理解。
請好好休息，黎明後再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Harad]
Would you like to take a ride to the water garden?
The ship only run once a day!
scripts.translation:
[哈拉德]
想乘船去水花園嗎？每天只開一班哦！

scripts.text:
^FF0000Please note that, any abnormal monster handling inside the instance such as taming, is not considered normal.^000000

^FF0000The party leader who received the quest for the 'Water Garden' or 'Water Garden Hard' must enter the instance to proceed. In the case of party leader changes, the instance will be cancelled and you may not proceed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^FF0000請注意，在副本中馴服魔物等處理方式不會計入正常任務進度。^000000

^FF0000必須由領取了“水花園”或“困難水花園”任務的隊長進入副本，才能繼續。中途更換隊長會導致副本取消，無法繼續。^000000

scripts.text: Create Water Garden
scripts.translation: 建立水花園

scripts.text: Create Water Garden Hard
scripts.translation: 建立困難水花園

scripts.text: ^0000CDGarden Entrance^000000

[Harad]
You can tell me if you want to enter the water garden.
But it's dangerous inside. You can't enter right now.
scripts.translation:
[哈拉德]
想進水花園就來找我。
不過裡面危險，現在還不能讓您進去。

scripts.text: - This MD is for level 180 or above. -
scripts.translation: - 此副本僅限180級及以上角色進入。-

scripts.text:
[Harad]
The instance has not been created yet.
Please check it.
scripts.translation:
[哈拉德]
副本尚未建立。
請確認一下。

scripts.text:
[Harad]
Enter the ^CC0000{0}^000000.
^0000CDEnter Water Garden
scripts.translation: ^0000CD進入水花園

scripts.text: Enter Water Garden Hard^000000
scripts.translation: 進入困難水花園^000000

scripts.text:
[Harad]
The instance has not been created yet.
Please check it.
scripts.translation:
[哈拉德]
副本尚未建立。
請確認一下。

scripts.text:
[Harad]
When the Water Garden MD has opened, please speak to me again and select ^0000CDEnter Water Garden^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈拉德]
水花園副本建立後，請再來找我，並選擇^0000CD進入水花園^000000。

scripts.text:
[Harad]
When the Water Garden Hard MD has opened, please speak to me again and select ^0000CDEnter Water Garden Hard^000000.
scripts.translation:
[哈拉德]
困難水花園副本建立後，請再來找我，並選擇^0000CD進入困難水花園^000000。

scripts.text: - You can enter the water garden after the party leader has entered the MD. -
scripts.translation: - 隊長進入副本後，其他隊員方可進入水花園。-

scripts.text:
[Hetilla]
 Guests, welcome to the water garden,
Are you going to see Papilla? Papilla's been very sensitive about the intruders lately...
scripts.translation:
[赫蒂拉]
客人，歡迎來到水花園。
您是要去看帕皮拉嗎？最近帕皮拉對入侵者非常敏感...

scripts.text:
[Hetilla]
Papillas are playing around here and there.
They use psychedelic materials from their wings to make short distance movements or use a dangerous magic over them.
scripts.translation:
[赫蒂拉]
帕皮拉們在這裡四處嬉戲。
它們會用翅膀上的致幻物質短距離移動，或施展危險的魔法。

scripts.text:
[Hetilla]
I warned you on advanced, but be careful.
Pruning all overgrown plants and animals opens the door to the next area at 3 o'clock.
scripts.translation:
[赫蒂拉]
已經提醒過您了，務必小心。
清理完所有過度繁殖的動植物，3點鐘方向通往下一區域的門就會開啟。
